basis: Current continuity through the 12/11 standing Crown mandate. Dated derived replacements; original survey preserved.

changes.old: His parents now reside at the 56-hectare Orsival estate nearby, Galahad has returned to his Collegium room in Auvrienne to complete expedition preparations.
changes.new: His parents reside at the 56-hectare Orsival estate nearby. Following his 12–17/10 visit it has a telephone and two watchhounds. His private papers and former Collegium belongings arrived on 22/10. Galahad has returned to Auvrienne and been appointed Royal Advisor; five approved household rifles still await delivery.

changes.old: Institutional and professional connections support his expanding research.
changes.new: Institutional and professional connections support his research. Galahad resigned salaried Collegium employment on 20/10, donated patronage and moved his personal belongings to the estate. His allocated military works completed 192 accepted trial rifles and three development rifles by 02/11. Ordel retains the paused staff; Galahad and Serault accompanied 187 military rifles to Cressault on 04/11, where company instruction began 05/11. Five House rifles still await delivery. All seven training days concluded 11/11. Galahad and Serault returned on 12/11; the Margrave appointed him Royal Advisor with a standing Crown mandate for industry, infrastructure and defensive preparedness. Additional resources remain to be proposed; the formal instrument is being amended.
